name: Bayan Run 2026
short_description: Bayan Run 2026 is a multi-distance road race, headlined by a half marathon, held October 11, 2026 in Balikpapan, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bayan Run 2026 is a road race scheduled for October 11, 2026, in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia. The event offers multiple distance options, including a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and 0.8 km races. It will be based at Lapangan Merdeka 3 and BSCC Dome. Registration has not yet been announced.

core_facts.venue: Lapangan Merdeka 3, Balikpapan | BSCC Dome, Balikpapan

faqs.question: When is Bayan Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Bayan Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. This date applies to the full event, which includes the half marathon along with the other distance categories offered at the race, all held on the same day in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Bayan Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Bayan Run 2026 offers five distance options: 21 km (the half marathon, listed as the primary distance at 21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and 0.8 km. This range allows participants of varying experience levels and fitness to choose a suitable distance.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held in Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia, with venues listed as Lapangan Merdeka 3 and the BSCC Dome, both in Balikpapan. These locations serve as the event's key sites for the various distance categories on race day.

faqs.question: Is registration open for Bayan Run 2026?
